posts.name: Aran Komatsuzaki
posts.text:
The decision model landscape is heating up, with models getting better every week. 

Still, Drex Max remains on top of the AA index a week after the paper, with competitive pricing and a clear lead over Jev (72.6 vs 66.2). 

Kudos to the team.
posts.quoted: This week, Drex Max v1.1 is the #1 decision model on the @ArtificialAnlys Decision Index, out of 19, and on the Pareto frontier 72.6, above Jev 1.14, Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna, on an index where 45% of the evaluation data is fully private and out of distribution. $103
